note: GENERATED by scripts/gen_publish_freshness_artifact.py. Do not hand-edit. The PUBLISHED measurement's drift against the current release — a different question from watch/freshness.json, which reports when anything was last measured and is satisfied by a one-episode probe. `measuredWith` is the version behind the LARGEST real campaign rather than the newest record, so a probe cannot displace a 350-episode run; see provael.watch.published_measurement. `isStale` is releasesBehind > staleAfterReleases, precomputed so a consumer rendering a banner does not reimplement the comparison. `staleAfterReleases` also appears in watch/release.json: the two cannot drift, because both render from provael.watch.STALE_AFTER_RELEASES and both are gated by `make check-docs`. There is deliberately NO generatedAt — a wall-clock field would make --check fail on a clean tree, which is the same reason watch/release.json and watch/measurements.json carry none.
